    },

    },

      "name": "complaint_dimension",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "The specific dimension being complained about is a genuine constitutive part of the 'complaints' half of the concept, and is meronymically 'an aspect of' the concept."
    },
    {
      "name": "emotional_engagement",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Emotional engagement (strongly engaging / off-putting / flat) is a substantive experiential aspect that reviews praise or complain about; it is a part-of the audience reaction rather than an external predictor."
    },
    {
      "name": "comparative_reference_type",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "How a review frames praise/complaint via comparison (favorable/unfavorable, sequel, genre benchmark) is a rhetorical facet of how praise and complaints are expressed."
    },
    {
      "name": "audience_recommendation_stance",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "restatement",
      "rationale": "The recommend/avoid stance is a downstream summary conclusion that follows from the praise and complaints rather than a constitutive part of them; it restates the net evaluative outcome."
    }
  ],
  "facet_columns": [
    "praise_dimension",
    "complaint_dimension",
    "emotional_engagement",
    "comparative_reference_type"
  ],
  "non_facet_columns": [
    "overall_sentiment_polarity",
    "audience_recommendation_stance"
  ],
  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.55,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.75,
  "rationale": "Four of six columns are genuine facets that carve the concept into non-overlapping constitutive aspects: what is praised, what is complained about, emotional engagement, and comparative framing. Two columns fail the meronymy test: overall_sentiment_polarity and audience_recommendation_stance are summary/restatement aggregates of the whole concept rather than parts of it. Mutual exclusivity is weakened because praise_dimension and complaint_dimension share nearly identical category vocabularies (acting, writing, story, direction, pacing, production_values) and emotional_engagement overlaps with the 'emotional_resonance' praise dimension and with the restatement columns' valence signal. Exhaustiveness is reasonably good for the praise/complaint content axes but the facet coverage is diluted rather than extended by the two non-facet summary columns."
}
